tags.name: PartnerProgram
tags.description: Allows for the querying of ACH partner programs available for use within the system.  Partner programs are used when sending a payment in order to specify pre-built configurations under which the payment will be processed, such as SEC code and ACH batch headers

tags.name: OutgoingAch
tags.description: Allows for querying and management of outgoing ACH payments

tags.name: IncomingAch
tags.description: Allow for querying and management of incoming ACH payments

tags.name: AccountControlType
tags.description: Allows for querying and managing of the Control Type (Dual or Single) on various accounts within the system
